review:
30 Coins is a Wazdan Coins slot with 30 positions to fill. The Grand Jackpot is 1,500x. Sticky to Infinity brings Mystery and Jackpot Mystery symbols that stay on the reels until the end of the next bonus, so the board fills up over time.

Cluster Collectors gather the values of neighbouring symbols, Cash Infinity keeps you working towards the bonus, and Chance Level lets you raise your bet for better odds. High volatility, 96.18% RTP. The Coins series was nominated for Game Mechanic and Game Feature of the Year at the CasinoBeats awards in 2024. A middle step between 20 Coins and 36 Coins. Try the 30 Coins demo free before choosing a Chance Level.
